newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.07 rupees up at 42.38 to the dollar on Monday in the kerb market amid rising dollar supply from abroad, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to open steady on Tuesday as current levels may spark dollar buying.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 6.0 percent, from Sunday's close at 6.30 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
